### Safety and Best Practices

- **Sanitization:** Soak manual rollers or stampers in 70% isopropyl alcohol for 5 to 10 minutes before and after every single use.[[1]](https://uk.drpen.co/products/bio-roller-g10-10-in-1-ultimate-microneedling-kit)
- **Single-use tips:** Never reuse motorized needle cartridges or contaminated manual heads to avoid severe skin irritation or infection.[[1]](https://realbeautylondon.com/products/microneedling-infusion-kit)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:780011654769563993,catalogid:11347301848974212841,gpcid:2875475029942675867,mid:576462827081657514&ibp=oshop)
- **Post-care:** Avoid harsh active ingredients like retinoids or chemical exfoliating acids for at least 24 hours after treatment. Stick to gentle hydrators.[[1]](https://www.instyle.com/beauty/skin/how-to-microneedle-at-home)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gn-gbL5ZhGk&t=74)[[3]](https://realbeautylondon.com/products/microneedling-infusion-kit)

- What specific **skin concerns** are you trying to treat (fine lines, acne scars, texture)?
- Do you prefer a **manual roller/stamper** or an **electric microneedling pen**?
- What is your preferred **budget**?
